name: Love/Saucer?!
source: 22-year old NEET Rakki, nigh losing hope of his task to find a girlfriend lest he be no longer "hardcore", beholds the crash landing of a flying saucer bearing a hopeless alien girl who agrees to a date, as well as a dangerous enemy.
translation: 22岁的尼特族Rakki，肩负着寻找女友的任务，否则就不能再算“硬核”。就在他几乎失去希望时，一架飞碟坠落在眼前，里面有一位同样走投无路、答应与他约会的外星少女，还有一个危险的敌人。
